description: TOC_Incident_Event_Reports is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Administrative", published or maintained by US Department of Transportation. Incident Event Reports table from TOC's Incident Awareness System - FOR OFFICIAL USE ONLY. Public availability to be determined under 5 U.S.C. § 552. Information contained herein is based on preliminary reports and is subject to revision. - Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI). Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Administrative". It has 5 columns, among them ArcGISObjectID, Official Report, Incident Lookup, Report Type, Name. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. Attribution given: US Department of Transportation. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
